title: Plate with a dimensioned hole (two loops)
script:
// a 40 x 25 plate; a hole of diameter 10 whose centre is 20 right and 12.5 up of the plate corner
// the corner sits on the origin; the outer loop is the plate, the inner circle is a hole (even-odd fill)
const sk = sketch('top')
sk.geom([
  { k: 'line', id: 1, a: [0.3, 0.2], b: [39, 0.2] },
  { k: 'line', id: 2, a: [39, 0.2], b: [39, 25.6] },
  { k: 'line', id: 3, a: [39, 25.6], b: [0.3, 25.6] },
  { k: 'line', id: 4, a: [0.3, 25.6], b: [0.3, 0.2] },
  { k: 'circle', id: 5, c: [19, 13.5], r: 4.4 }
])
sk.rules([
  { k: 'coincident', a: 1, aEnd: 'b', b: 2, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 2, aEnd: 'b', b: 3, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 3, aEnd: 'b', b: 4, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 4, aEnd: 'b', b: 1, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'horizontal', a: 1 },
  { k: 'vertical', a: 2 },
  { k: 'horizontal', a: 3 },
  { k: 'vertical', a: 4 },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 1, aEnd: 'a', b: -1, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'distance', a: 1, aEnd: 'a', b: 1, bEnd: 'b', value: 40 },
  { k: 'distance', a: 2, aEnd: 'a', b: 2, bEnd: 'b', value: 25 },
  { k: 'diameter', a: 5, value: 10 },
  { k: 'distanceX', a: 1, aEnd: 'a', b: 5, bEnd: 'c', value: 20 },
  { k: 'distanceY', a: 1, aEnd: 'a', b: 5, bEnd: 'c', value: 12.5 }
])
const part = extrude(sk, 10)
expect: One body with a hole: 40*25*10 - pi*5^2*10 = 9214.60 mm3. If the hole were filled it would read 10000. dof 0.

occt.refused: Sketch 1: rule 9 names geometry -1, which this sketch does not have

title: Regular hexagon from equal sides and a construction circle
script:
// six lines, five equal-length rules, six vertices on a construction circle of radius 20 centred on the origin, one vertical side
const sk = sketch('top')
sk.geom([
  { k: 'line', id: 1, a: [17.320508, -10], b: [17.320508, 10] },
  { k: 'line', id: 2, a: [17.320508, 10], b: [0, 20] },
  { k: 'line', id: 3, a: [0, 20], b: [-17.320508, 10] },
  { k: 'line', id: 4, a: [-17.320508, 10], b: [-17.320508, -10] },
  { k: 'line', id: 5, a: [-17.320508, -10], b: [0, -20] },
  { k: 'line', id: 6, a: [0, -20], b: [17.320508, -10] },
  { k: 'circle', id: 7, c: [0.3, -0.2], r: 19.4, construction: true }
])
sk.rules([
  { k: 'coincident', a: 1, aEnd: 'b', b: 2, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 2, aEnd: 'b', b: 3, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 3, aEnd: 'b', b: 4, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 4, aEnd: 'b', b: 5, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 5, aEnd: 'b', b: 6, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 6, aEnd: 'b', b: 1, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'equal', a: 1, b: 2 },
  { k: 'equal', a: 2, b: 3 },
  { k: 'equal', a: 3, b: 4 },
  { k: 'equal', a: 4, b: 5 },
  { k: 'equal', a: 5, b: 6 },
  { k: 'pointOnObject', a: 1, aEnd: 'a', b: 7 },
  { k: 'pointOnObject', a: 2, aEnd: 'a', b: 7 },
  { k: 'pointOnObject', a: 3, aEnd: 'a', b: 7 },
  { k: 'pointOnObject', a: 4, aEnd: 'a', b: 7 },
  { k: 'pointOnObject', a: 5, aEnd: 'a', b: 7 },
  { k: 'pointOnObject', a: 6, aEnd: 'a', b: 7 },
  { k: 'coincident', a: 7, aEnd: 'c', b: -1, bEnd: 'a' },
  { k: 'radius', a: 7, value: 20 },
  { k: 'vertical', a: 1 }
])
const part = extrude(sk, 10)
expect: One body. Area (3*sqrt(3)/2)*20^2 = 1039.23, volume 10392.3 mm3. dof 0 (solidcraft may misreport on an already-regular start).

title: Round the top rim of a cylinder (edge between top and side)

title: Round an edge of a block that has had a hole cut through it
expect: PASS. The name is primitive(op1, +z / +x) on the cut result, resolved on op1's own shape (7 faces; the top face has a hole but its edge to +x is whole).

title: Name an edge of the box, round it on the holed body
expect: PASS. The name belongs to box1 (resolved on box1's own shape), the pick is then checked to be whole on the holed target before it is used.

title: Shell open at the top of a plate that has a hole (annular face)
expect: PASS. Volume = OCCT's and brep-rs's 2656.478. The top face's centroid is IN the hole, so the pick is an interior point of the face, chosen on the target body and verified with solidcraft's own pick test (phase 4 first version over-refused or mis-picked here).

title: Round the rim of a pocket wall (carried + swept + between)
expect: PASS. The edge is between carried(plate top) and swept(pocket tool, edge 0); the wall is read off the tool's own shape and lifted onto the pocketed plate with its normal flipped, and solidcraft's persistent names agree.

title: Counterbore (refused) and a named-edge round (built)
expect: Mixed: base, post and other build, the NAMED round now builds too (phase 3 refused it); only the counterbored hole is refused, with its sentence. Built volume = base 12000 + post 2000 + rounded box.

title: Shell: a closed hollow box (no open face)
expect: REFUSAL by this spike's translator: a shell needs a face to remove and a closed hollow box is not mapped. brep-rs builds it (40*40*20 - 36*36*16 = 11264 mm3). The box itself still builds (32000).

expectRefused.contains: closed hollow box is not mapped

title: Ambiguous name: the top face is split in two
expect: EXPECTED REFUSAL: the shell is refused with a sentence that names the name and says it matches 2 faces. The channelled block (60*40*20 - 10*40*5 = 46000) stays. Measured on brep-rs for the same block: this shell is refused there too (for its own reason, a blind cut), round(top/left) resolves by picking ONE of the two pieces (centroid -30,0,10) and round(top/right) resolves to null. This demo refuses every spelling with the count instead of choosing a piece.
